purpose: The optional theme hooks of the Grammar: custom properties an app's theme layer (brand.css, on :root and the dark blocks) may set beside HeroUI's tokens. The Grammar never declares one; each rule reads it with its fallback, so an app that sets none draws exactly the default look. `scripts/check-theme-hooks.mts` holds that every hook listed here is read by a rule with this fallback; `@starci/stylelint-canon` admits these names in brand.css (`starci/theme-layer-shape`).

hooks.name: --starci-core-schedule-current
hooks.means: the fill of today's cell

hooks.name: --starci-core-sidebar-selected
hooks.means: the fill of the selected item

hooks.name: --starci-core-sidebar-selected-foreground
hooks.means: the words and glyph of the selected item

hooks.name: --starci-core-sidebar-selected-weight
hooks.means: the label weight of the selected item

hooks.name: --starci-core-sidebar-weight
hooks.means: the label weight of an unselected item

hooks.name: --starci-core-tabs-indicator
hooks.means: the colour of the selected tab's underline

hooks.name: --starci-core-field-ring
hooks.part: every field (Input, Textarea, Select, ComboBox, SearchField, NumberField, the date and time fields, OtpInput, CopyField, a native control in Field)
hooks.means: the colour of a field's focus ring; buttons and links keep `--focus`

hooks.name: --starci-core-field-ring-width
hooks.means: the width of a field's focus ring (a Select trigger keeps the vendor width)

hooks.name: --grammar-choice-ring
hooks.means: the inset ring an unselected choice draws

hooks.name: --starci-core-plate
hooks.means: the fill of an unselected toggle plate

hooks.name: --starci-core-plate-border
hooks.means: the edge of an unselected plate (a Select pill keeps the field border)

hooks.name: --starci-core-plate-selected
hooks.means: the fill of the selected plate

hooks.name: --starci-core-plate-selected-foreground
hooks.means: the words of the selected plate

hooks.name: --starci-core-bubble-incoming
hooks.means: the fill of the other party's message

hooks.name: --starci-core-bubble-incoming-foreground
hooks.means: its words

hooks.name: --starci-core-bubble-incoming-border
hooks.part: MessageBubble (incoming), in a thread and out of one
hooks.means: its edge (one look on every host)

hooks.name: --starci-core-bubble-outgoing
hooks.means: the fill of the reader's own message (the soft tone keeps the accent soft pair)

hooks.name: --starci-core-bubble-outgoing-foreground
hooks.means: its words, links, mentions and code tint

hooks.name: --starci-core-bubble-outgoing-border
hooks.means: its edge

hooks.name: --starci-core-message-card
hooks.means: the fill of a message card

hooks.name: --starci-core-message-card-border
hooks.means: its edge

hooks.name: --starci-core-quote
hooks.means: the fill of a quote

hooks.name: --starci-core-quote-edge
hooks.means: a rule on its start edge

hooks.name: --starci-core-switch-track-off
hooks.means: the fill of an unselected switch track; on, the track stays the accent

hooks.name: --starci-core-switch-track-off-border
hooks.means: a hairline on the unselected track, drawn as an inset outline (the track keeps its size and the focus ring)

hooks.name: --starci-core-card-radius
hooks.part: every card surface (SurfaceCard, Board and its columns, a framed EmptyNotice), through --starci-core-surface-radius
hooks.means: the corner radius of a card, 24px at --radius 0.5rem

hooks.name: --starci-core-track
hooks.part: Progress (bar and steps), Meter (bar and segments), ProgressCircle, ProportionBar
hooks.means: the fill of an empty measure track; the Switch's off track keeps its own hook

hooks.name: --starci-core-grid-section-divider
hooks.means: a hairline between two section columns, in the middle of their gap; never before the row-start column nor in the one-column grid
